### StoredValueLedger {#type-commerz-storedvalue-ledger-contracts-storedvalueledger}

`Commerz\StoredValue\Ledger\Contracts\StoredValueLedger`

Read-only query and trial-balance verification surface for the immutable stored-value double-entry ledger.

```php
interface StoredValueLedger {
    // Lists ledger entries for an account in ascending posting order (`id ASC`).
    entriesForAccount(\Commerz\StoredValue\Ledger\Data\AccountId $accountId, ?\Commerz\StoredValue\Ledger\Enums\LedgerEntrySide $side = null, int $limit = 100): array;
    // Verifies the double-entry trial balance for an account (`sum(debits) === sum(credits)` and `INV-SV-001`).
    isBalanced(\Commerz\StoredValue\Ledger\Data\AccountId $accountId): bool;
    // Returns both balanced legs of a double-entry journal by `journalId`.
    journalEntries(string $journalId): array;
}
```
